description: A restaurant POS and technology comparison aimed at the 90-day pre-opening window. Independent evaluations for first-time owners.

authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our team of former restaurant operators and hospitality tech experts reviews every platform.

editorial.how_we_test: We evaluate restaurant technology based on features, pricing transparency, and support. We test platforms firsthand or interview operators who use them daily in high-volume environments.
editorial.how_we_make_money: Institute of Restaurants is an independent comparison site, not an accreditation body. We may earn a vendor referral bounty when you choose a vendor through links on our site (for example, Toast, TouchBistro, or Square). This allows us to provide our research for free.
editorial.corrections: We strive for accuracy. If you find an error in our pricing or feature data, please contact us. We correct factual errors promptly and update our reviews as platforms evolve.
